key_insight: SrTiO3-xHx oxyhydrides strongly favor a cis O4H2 local anion arrangement, and this ordering is highly sensitive to the DFT+U choice used to build the model.
engineering_relevance: Accurate prediction of anion ordering in oxyhydrides requires calibrating DFT+U against HSE06, which is important for designing and stabilizing energy-materials with controlled hydrogen incorporation.
method: Built a cluster expansion for SrTiO3-xHx using HSE06 hybrid-DFT energetics.
Benchmarked multiple DFT+U settings and identified U = 3.3 eV as an HSE06 proxy.
Used ground-state searches and Monte Carlo sampling to assess ordering and stability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to ~100 meV/anion variation in mixing energies across DFT+U choices and a ~200 meV per hydride stabilization for the cis configuration.
watch_item: Because the ordering energetics depend strongly on the chosen U value, conclusions from lower-cost CE workflows should be validated against key HSE06 configurations.
paper_title: Long- and Short-Range Anion Order in SrTiO$_{3-x}$H$_x$ Perovskite Oxyhydrides: DFT+$U$ Sensitivity and HSE06 Cluster Expansion
